home.title: Rabaed
home.tagline: Construction projects, one place, each company sees only its own work.
home.documentNumberLabel: Document Numbers read left to right in every language:

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.invalid: That email and password don't match.

acceptInvitation.title: Accept your invitation
acceptInvitation.hint: Choose a password of at least {min} characters.
acceptInvitation.invalid: This invitation link is not valid. It may have been used or have expired; ask for a new one.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Everyone at {company} on Rabaed. Only your Company sees this list.
members.name: Name
members.invitationLink: Invitation created. Send this link to the new Member; it works once and expires.
members.alreadyAMember: That email already belongs to a Member of your Company.
members.registeredWithAnotherCompany: This person is already registered on Rabaed with another Company.
members.confirmReactivateEmail: {email} belongs to a deactivated Member of your Company. Reactivate them? They keep their Signature and records.
members.reactivated: Member reactivated. They can sign in again with their password.
members.invalid: Check the email and both names.
members.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will be signed out at once and can no longer sign in.
members.confirmReactivate: Reactivate {name}? They keep their Signature and records.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.empty: You are not on any Project yet.
projects.emptyCreator: You are not on any Project yet. Create one below.
projects.codeHint: 2 to 10 letters or digits, used in Document Numbers.
projects.invalid: Check both names and the project code.
projects.notCreator: Only a Project Creator can create a Project.
projects.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw this invitation? You can invite the same CR number again later.

participants.title: Company Projects
participants.subtitle: Every Project {company} takes part in. Add your Members to each one.
participants.empty: Your Company is not on any Project yet.
participants.noMembers: None of your Members are on this Project yet.
participants.addMember: Add a Member of your Company
participants.confirmRemove: Remove {name} from this Project? They lose access at once.
participants.notAdmin: Only a Project Admin can add Participants.
participants.alreadyParticipant: That Company is already on this Project.
participants.invitationSent: If this company is on Rabaed, its Authorized Person will receive the invitation; if not, Rabaed will contact you to onboard them.
participants.confirmDecline: Decline this invitation? Your Company won't join the Project.

dimensions.title: Trades & Locations
dimensions.codeHint: 2 to 6 letters or digits, used in Document Numbers.
dimensions.invalid: Check both names and the code.
dimensions.notAdmin: Only a Project Admin can add Trades and Locations.
dimensions.duplicateCode: That code is already used at this level.

scopes.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? It stays on the Work Items that already use it, but won't be offered for new ones.
scopes.invalid: Enter the name in English and Arabic.
scopes.notFound: This is no longer available. Refresh the page.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.participantsHint: Choose which Trades and Locations each Participant covers. Choosing a Location covers everything inside it. Each Company's Authorized Person narrows this for its own Members.
visibility.memberHint: The Trades and Locations this Member covers, chosen from what your Company covers on this Project. Choosing a Location covers everything inside it.
visibility.exceedsParticipant: A Member can't cover more than their Company does.

workItems.title: Submittals
workItems.empty: No Work Items you can see yet.
workItems.noTradesCovered: Your Visibility on this Project covers no Trade yet, so you can't raise a Work Item. Ask your Company's Authorized Person.
workItems.invalid: Give a Subject and a Trade.
workItems.notContractor: Only a Contractor can raise a Material Submittal.
workItems.outsideVisibility: Choose a Trade and Location your Visibility covers.

form.title: Form
form.invalid: Some answers aren't valid. Check the fields marked in the Form.
form.notEditable: These answers can't be changed any more.
form.newVersion: A new version of this Form was just published. Check your answers and save again.
form.valueNotFound: A Trade, Location or Scope you chose is no longer offered. Check the Form and save again.

actions.title: Transitions
actions.internalNoteHelp: Optional. Only your Company sees it, even when the item goes to another Company. Anything for them goes in Chat or the Form.
actions.notHolder: Someone else holds this step now.
actions.noStepPool: Nobody in your Company can hold the next step yet. Ask your Authorized Person to give someone the Position.
actions.nextStepUnavailable: This can't be handed over yet: the next step has nobody to take it. Ask a Project Admin.
actions.notAvailable: This Transition isn't available any more.
actions.formIncomplete: Complete the Form first: the fields to fix are marked in it.
actions.saveFirst: Your answers couldn't be saved, so nothing was sent. Check the Form.
actions.tryAgain: The answers changed meanwhile. Try again.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.limits: PDF, images, Office files, drawings, text or zip, up to {size}. Once sent, Documents can't be changed.
attachments.tooLarge: This file is too large. The limit is {size}.
attachments.wrongType: This type of file can't be attached.
attachments.notEditable: Documents can't be changed any more.
attachments.frozen: This Document was sent, so it can't be removed.
attachments.forbidden: Your Position doesn't allow attaching Documents.
attachments.notUploaded: The file didn't finish uploading. Attach it again.
attachments.tooManyFiles: This field has all the files it takes. Remove one to add another.

history.title: History
history.internal: Internal: only your Company sees this.
